about: MIRAGE test prompt set. All data is fictional: Aadhaar numbers are generated with a valid Verhoeff digit, cards are published test numbers, keys are made up. 'expected' lists what the on-device rules must find. 'names' lists person or company names a user would expect hidden; rules alone cannot catch these (they need the Always mask list or the optional AWS check), so they are tracked separately and reported as a limit.
